##### Project general facts

Vedaire Residences by Elton is a boutique residential development set in the heart of Meydan, offering a refined collection of homes that blend contemporary elegance with timeless architectural character. Positioned on a prominent corner plot, the building is designed to capture panoramic views of Burj Khalifa and surrounding green landscapes. Clean lines, balanced proportions, and expansive glazing define the architecture, while interiors are thoughtfully planned with open layouts, natural light, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow, creating a calm and sophisticated living environment.

The lifestyle at Vedaire is shaped by a curated selection of amenities designed for both relaxation and connection. A rooftop beach-style pool with skyline views forms the centerpiece, complemented by a fully equipped fitness centre and dedicated yoga deck for wellness-focused living. Residents also benefit from a library lounge, business hub, and social spaces including an outdoor cinema, BBQ areas, firepit lounges, and pet-friendly zones. Children’s play areas and landscaped communal spaces further enhance the sense of community, creating a balanced environment for families and individuals alike.

Interiors are finished with modern, high-quality materials, combining soft textures and elegant detailing with integrated smart home technology for enhanced comfort and control. Open kitchens come fully equipped with appliances and are designed to blend seamlessly with living spaces. Residences are offered semi-furnished, featuring built-in elements and refined finishes that provide a sophisticated foundation while allowing for personal customization.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan is an extraordinary community situated in the heart of Dubai, known for its blend of luxury, sophistication, and world-class amenities. Spanning over a vast area, Meydan offers a unique living experience that combines urban convenience with a tranquil and scenic environment.

One of the standout features of Meydan is its iconic Meydan Racecourse, which hosts renowned horse racing events, including the prestigious Dubai World Cup. The racecourse creates an aura of excitement and elegance, attracting enthusiasts from around the world. Residents of Meydan have the privilege of witnessing the thrilling races firsthand and immersing themselves in the vibrant atmosphere that surrounds this prestigious venue.

Green spaces are integral to the design of Meydan, with expansive parks, landscaped gardens, and tree-lined boulevards adorning the community. Residents can enjoy leisurely walks, bike rides, or picnics in these serene surroundings, offering a refreshing escape from the bustling city life. The abundance of open spaces also provides opportunities for outdoor activities and social gatherings, fostering a sense of community and well-being.
